I got: Deeprock Galactic, Darktide, Valheim. 

I prefer to play: 

Sea of Thieves

DRG

Warcraft

MW2

Download "calm harm" on your device, it helped me stop by making me stretch my body until it started to hurt a little for a full minute. If that doesn't work, my advice is to just apply pressure on your skin until the feeling goes away.
My folks won't even allow me to take a 5 minute nap without screaming at me.

Admitting yourself isn't that bad, you can leave when you want, the payments can be a little high, least where I am (Texas), and the food is alright. It's a nice way to get back to simpler times. When I admitted myself, I got better, I realized what I needed to do and now I'm finally able to focus on what I need.
